title: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models

mechanism.domainTask: Cross-model prompt transfer for coding, agentic, planning, and reasoning tasks
mechanism.populationDetail: MAP-RPE maintains a prompt database partitioned into three evolutionary islands with periodic migration.
mechanism.archiveDetail: A global best prompt p* is explicitly retained according to the combined performance-and-behavior score; per-island variants belong to the evolving population database.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Rewritten prompts are inserted into island databases and a global best prompt is updated elitistically; the policy for evicting entries when the fixed 1000-record archive fills is not specified.
mechanism.generationDetail: The reflection model broadly rewrites a selected parent prompt using evaluation feedback and same-island inspirations; the unseen-task adapter also transforms a source prompt using learned transfer guidance.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: MAP-RPE combines task performance with a behavioral score covering syntax, entry-point validity, safety patterns, and undesirable constructs; textual reflection summaries also guide the next prompt candidate.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The current island supplies one parent and additional inspirations. Configured exploitation/exploration/elite-selection proportions are explicit, but the exact sampling implementation for each mode is underspecified; global p* is a separate best-so-far prompt.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: A learned cross-model transfer mapping converts calibrated prompt pairs into meta-guidance and applies it zero-shot to unseen source prompts, a prompt-migration workflow not fully represented by ordinary evolutionary parent-offspring fields.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/PromptBridge Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Existing placements cover workflow/search-space framing, repeated experiments, island-based reference selection, and static role-based models. Consider missing island population, prompt-structure, broad prompt-rewriting, feedback, and fixed explore-exploit coverage. Do not overstate archive eviction or exact parent-sampling rules.
